title: Free-to-play Fantasy Concept
description: Built a prototype using Claude & Cursor to explore a free-to-play plus subscription direction, helping stakeholders evaluate the concept. Direction was explored, not launched.

title: Avatar Generator
description: Built a working demo using Google AI Studio that converts a user photo into a sports-pose avatar while preserving facial features. Later built and shipped by a different team.

title: AI Movie Curator
description: Built an AI-powered movie curation prototype using Google AI Studio that recommends one hidden gem instead of overwhelming users with endless lists.
